single_prn_matching.rule: return every case in the first nonempty priority stratum; parameter tuple is rho_db, delta_tau_chips, delta_f_hz, delta_phi_rad

receiver_frame_convention.positive_delay: counterfeit code replica is delayed by positive chips relative to clean receiver coordinate

templates.fixed: triangular nine-tap spatial response at requested delay times exp(+j*2*pi*requested_doppler*t)
templates.oracle: same triangular response evaluated once at the frozen receiver-frame effective delay trajectory with carrier phase obtained by trapezoidal integration of effective Doppler
templates.alternative: one additional fitted complex template coefficient
templates.label: POST_HOC_ORACLE_DIAGNOSTIC

projection_ratio: squared residual projection on the clean-orthogonalized template divided by residual energy and template energy; clipped only for floating-point tolerance to [0,1]

temporal_windows.rule: half-open wall-clock blocks on exact common epochs; empty blocks omitted; no score or threshold selection
temporal_windows.label: POST_HOC_DIAGNOSTIC

hypotheses.H2: relative phase cancellation; rho and phase confounding retained
hypotheses.H5: PRN-specific dominance; independence not inferred from 3-of-4 failure alone

oracle_interpretation.restore_rule: oracle coordinate meets frozen recovery tolerances and oracle delta_BIC and projection ratio both exceed fixed requested-coordinate diagnostics for failed targets without degrading success comparator separation
oracle_interpretation.nonrestore_interpretation: physical absence, cancellation, or analytic-template mismatch remains possible

factorial_rule: descriptive tables only by rho, phase, delay, Doppler, dataset, PRN, and rho*phase; if cells are sparse or factors are aliased report INSUFFICIENT_FACTORIAL_IDENTIFIABILITY; no causal p-values

recommendation_truth_table.Frozen corrected observer confirmation: only if oracle clearly restores F1/F2 targets, fixed-to-oracle projection and delta_BIC improve consistently, success comparators are not degraded, and committed R1a gain/AWGN/collapsed control separation remains true
recommendation_truth_table.Terminate MOSAIC: otherwise, including inseparable causes, oracle failure, instability/baseline dominance, or need for post-hoc score/threshold selection
